css: body{font-family:'DM Sans','Inter','Noto Sans TC','Noto Sans JP',sans-serif}.copy{text-align:center}.badge{display:inline-block;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-radius:999px;padding:16px 38px;font-weight:700;font-size:38px;box-shadow:0 12px 30px #0000000f}h1{font-weight:800;font-size:var(--title);line-height:1.12;margin-top:40px;letter-spacing:-.02em}h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--em,#E0568B)}p{font-size:50px;line-height:1.5;margin:36px auto 0;max-width:960px;color:var(--muted,#6F6380);font-weight:500}
